title: ServiceNow API gateway timeout cascade — connection pool exhausted on prod-gw-01
description: The ServiceNow integration gateway on prod-gw-01 exhausted its HTTP connection pool (512 connections) beginning at 08:42 UTC. Downstream services including the incident correlation pipeline and the CMDB sync job experienced 15–30 s response delays, triggering circuit-breaker opens across 4 dependent consumers.

title: Vault certificate renewal failure — TLS cert on vault-01 expired
description: The auto-renewal CronJob for the Vault PKI engine missed its 30-day window due to a Kubernetes namespace RBAC misconfiguration introduced in the v2.14 Helm chart upgrade. The vault-01 TLS certificate expired at 00:00 UTC, causing all mutual-TLS handshakes from the API tier to fail silently.

title: Neo4j query latency spike — p95 > 3 s on knowledge-graph-prod
description: Prometheus alerting fired at p95 query latency exceeding 3 000 ms on the Neo4j knowledge-graph-prod cluster. Root-cause analysis suggests unbounded Cypher traversals introduced by the latest vendor-knowledge agent update (v1.8.2) which removed depth limits on multi-hop queries.

title: Grafana dashboard data gaps — metrics missing for 22-minute window
description: Grafana dashboards across all tenants reported a 22-minute data gap (08:20–08:42 UTC). The Prometheus remote-write endpoint on metrics-aggregator-02 was unreachable during a rolling restart, causing metric samples to be dropped rather than buffered.

title: PostgreSQL read replica lag exceeds 60 s — tenant isolation risk
description: The primary-to-replica replication lag on pg-replica-03 climbed to 87 s due to a large analytical query running on the replica without a statement timeout. RLS policies enforced on the replica remained consistent, but query-based isolation checks that relied on near-real-time replica reads may have returned stale data for up to 3 tenants.

title: Redis Cluster node eviction storm — 3 nodes enter OOM state
description: Three of six Redis Cluster nodes entered an OOM condition simultaneously after a burst of cache-stampede writes generated by the LLM embedding layer during a reindex job. The noeviction policy was replaced by allkeys-lru in the last config push, causing 40 % of the hot-key set to be evicted unexpectedly.

title: Keycloak SSO login failure rate > 5 % — 503 errors on auth endpoint
description: Keycloak returned HTTP 503 on 5.3 % of login attempts over a 12-minute window. The Keycloak pod's JVM heap was exhausted following a misconfigured realm export job that held open JDBC connections to the Postgres user-store indefinitely.

title: Jira webhook delivery failures — integration queue backlog of 2,400 events
description: The Jira integration webhook receiver failed to acknowledge events for 18 minutes, causing Jira to retry delivery 3 times per event and build a queue backlog of 2,400 unprocessed change records. The receiver was blocked by a deadlock in the NormalizationEngine introduced in v1.7.1.

title: Datadog APM trace ingestion gap — spans missing for checkout-service
description: Datadog APM reported a 9-minute gap in trace ingestion for the checkout-service. The Datadog agent on checkout-node-02 was restarted by the Kubernetes liveness probe because the agent's gRPC listener was blocked waiting on an unreachable Datadog backend.

title: LLM gateway latency P99 > 8 s — embedding model overloaded
description: The IIVKIS LLM Gateway's embedding endpoint reported P99 latency of 8.4 s, breaching the 5 s SLO. The shared GPU node running the local embedding model received 3× normal traffic from a parallel re-ingestion job launched without rate limiting.

title: Correlation Engine throughput degradation — processing 500 signals/min vs 2000 target
description: The CE processing pipeline fell to 25 % of target throughput following an unintended rollout of a debug-logging configuration that serialised signal enrichment to a single worker goroutine. The backlog of unprocessed signals grew to 12,000 within 20 minutes.

title: Grafana alert storm — 180 duplicate alerts fired in 5 min
description: A misconfigured Grafana alert rule that lacked a pending-period guard fired 180 times in 5 minutes when the metrics-aggregator-02 restart caused transient 0-value samples. The alert channel flooded Slack and PagerDuty, masking genuine critical alerts.

title: PagerDuty escalation policy misconfiguration — on-call rotation skipped
description: The PagerDuty on-call rotation for the Platform SRE team was not advanced correctly after a schedule update, leaving INC-3001 and INC-3005 unacknowledged for 22 minutes beyond the escalation threshold.

title: API error rate spike — 4xx response ratio > 10 % on /api/v1/correlation
description: The /api/v1/correlation endpoints returned a 4xx ratio of 12 % for 8 minutes. Cause: a schema migration that added a NOT NULL column without a default value was deployed without a coordinated app rollout, causing validation errors for existing request payloads.

title: Kubernetes node NotReady — worker-node-07 kernel OOM-killed
description: worker-node-07 entered NotReady state after the Linux OOM killer terminated the containerd shim process. The node was running both the LLM GPU workload and an unbounded log-tailing sidecar that leaked memory over 6 hours.

title: WAF false-positive blocking — legitimate GraphQL introspection queries rejected
description: The IIVKIS WAF's SQL-injection detection rule triggered on GraphQL introspection query bodies that contained the token 'union', blocking all GraphQL schema discovery requests from the portal frontend for 14 minutes.

title: Orchestrator memory leak — 1.8 GB growth over 4 h
description: The IIVKIS orchestrator process exhibited steady memory growth from 400 MB to 1.8 GB over 4 hours. Heap profiling revealed that completed AgentRequest objects were retained in the circuit-breaker registry's event-history buffer indefinitely when the buffer-flush interval was set to 0.

title: Multi-tenant RBAC drift — operator role granted admin privileges in tenant-beta
description: An Infrastructure-as-Code drift was detected: the operator role in tenant-beta had the 'incident:delete' permission mapped to both operator and admin policy, effectively granting operator users admin-level deletion capability. Discovered during scheduled OPA policy audit.

title: Knowledge-graph ingestion stalled — vendor advisory feed timeout
description: The vendor-knowledge agent failed to complete its nightly ingestion run because the upstream vendor advisory feed returned HTTP 408 after 30 s. The agent's retry policy was configured with 0 retries, so 480 new vendor advisories were not ingested, leaving the knowledge base 24 h stale.

title: Full-stack degradation cascade — 5 services affected simultaneously
description: Between 09:00 and 09:35 UTC, the combination of INC-3001 (gateway timeout), INC-3005 (replica lag), INC-3006 (Redis OOM), INC-3010 (LLM latency) and INC-3015 (K8s node failure) created a compound degradation cascade. End-to-end incident creation latency reached 45 s (normal: 200 ms). The CE correctly identified and grouped 4 of the 5 incidents into correlation group cg-3004.
